items.title: 6.5.1 Tracking the Origin of Products (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Blockchain technology supply chain ke alag alag stages (qadam / hisse) mein products ke origin (kahan se aaye) aur safar track karne ka transparent (saaf, sab ke saamne) aur mehfooz tareeqa deti hai. Har transaction decentralized ledger par record hone se blockchain yaqeeni banata hai ke kachcha maal dene wale (raw material supplier) se aakhri customer tak har qadam track ho sake (traceable) aur woh badla na ja sake (immutable). Is tracking se products ke asli hone ki verification (jaanch kar pakka karna), quality ka yaqeen, aur kisi masle ki jarr (source) dhoondne mein madad milti hai.

blocks.alt: Ek daire ke gird nishanon wali chhe hari tiles, teer ghari ki sui ki simt mein: Supplier, Manufacturer, Fabricator, Intermediary, Retailer aur Customer (End User-Consumer), aur phir wapas Supplier.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.3: Blockchain se chocolate ka origin track karna (kitab ki Figure 6.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Figure 6.3 mein supply chain ke alag alag hisson ke darmiyan rishte dikhaye gaye hain. Blockchain suppliers, manufacturers (banane wale), fabricators (purze jorne wale), intermediaries (beech wale), retailers (dukandar) aur customers ke darmiyan har len den record karta hai. Har transaction blockchain par mehfooz likhi jati hai, is liye product ka origin se end consumer (aakhri khareedar) tak ka safar dekha ja sakta hai. Maslan jab supplier manufacturer ko kachcha maal deta hai to ek record ban kar blockchain mein jur jata hai. Yahi kaam har stage par chalta hai: fabricator, intermediary aur retailer sab product ki transparent aur verify ho sakne wali tareekh mein apna hissa likhte hain. Aakhir mein customer yeh data dekh kar product ka origin aur us ka expected standards (jis quality ki umeed hai) par poora utarna confirm kar sakta hai.

blocks.title: Did You Know?
blocks.text: Kuch artists apna digital art bechne ke liye blockchain istemal karte hain. Har art piece ka ek unique digital signature hota hai jo saabit karta hai ke yahi asli (original) hai.

blocks.prompt: Blockchain ko IoT ke saath jorna supply chain management ko kaise behtar banata hai (exercise short question 6)?
blocks.explanation: IoT sensors har stage par maal ki jagah, temperature aur waqt jaisa data khud record karte hain, aur yeh readings blockchain par likhne se woh chhed chhaar se mehfooz aur chain ke sab logon ke liye saaf ho jati hain. Is se khareedar ko bharosa hota hai ke maal kahan se aur kaise aaya, masle ki jarr jaldi milti hai, aur dhoka aur ghaltiyan kam hoti hain. (Kitab 6.6.2.2 mein batati hai ke IoT aur blockchain ka mel IoT data ka tamper-proof record deta hai; sensors ki details aam maloomat hai.)

items: Har len den decentralized ledger par: supplier se customer tak har qadam traceable aur immutable.
Customer product ka origin aur quality confirm kar sakta hai (chocolate ki misal, Figure 6.3).
